target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Family-owned since 1947 (78 years of heritage). Specializes in Old Fashioned Hickory Smoked meats including Jerky, Smokies, Bacon, Hams. Fresh cut meats available 7 days a week: Steaks, Ribs, Pork Chops, Chicken. Expanded produce area with lettuce, peppers, cucumbers, carrots, corn, pickles. Featured products: Havarti Butter Cheese ($10.99/lb), Rib End Pork Chops ($4.49/lb), Corned Beef ($9.99/lb), Chuck Roast ($9.99/lb), Hot Pepper Trail Bologna ($9.99/lb). Value propositions: Premium Quality (time-honored techniques), Local Sourcing (partners with Miles Farmers Market), Family-Owned (since 1947). Perfect match for MVP's livestock selection and farm-to-table model.

target_buyer_2.type: USDA Inspected Whole Animal Butcher Shop
target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Artisan butcher specializing in nitrate-free charcuterie. Ohio Proud member since 2019. Tagline: 'No nitrates, no nonsense' - explicitly no celery powder or added nitrites. Products: salamis, hams, bacons, beef, pork, chicken. All sausages and salamis made from scratch recipes with in-house ground spices and natural casings. Offers bundles for stocking up rather than buying by quarter/side. Strong social media presence (Facebook, Instagram). USDA inspected whole animal butcher shop focusing on traditional techniques. Would benefit from digital livestock ordering and cut sheet management.
